printed_header: encouraging Leisure time for those retired is a time of many opportunities if channeled through guided programs, assisted by the communities. However, it is not possible to sustain these programs if there is no place to meet regularly. Neither is it possible to conduct meetings if the Golden Age Group has to travel too far for more efficient gatherings, or be lost in the competition of other elderly groups. Fortunately for Lunenburg, it is now possible to use the facilities of the new community house at White Street where already there is an organized plan in the making. Several of the senior citizens residing at the complex have joined with the Coun- cil to assure a program of activities for 1971, and have asked to be represented on the local Council. The Town has been able to afford a small sum for this recreational program to date, and it is hoped that added interest in the forthcoming year may re- ward the Town with increasing interest in the elderly citizens.
